Ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
Ectoplasm.basicInfo:
Ectoplasm, a pro hero on U.A. Academy's faculty who teaches the Hero Course first-years mathematics and runs practical exercises and exams with his clones. Tall and lean; a black helmet with blank white eyes and bared teeth behind a jaw guard, a tan high-collared coat over a black suit, prosthetic legs below the knee.
Speaking Style: Deep, measured and direct; sets challenges, not encouragement, and grades in a few exact sentences.
Combat Role: Area control by numbers: clones surround and contain while he kicks on his prosthetics; a solid hit dissolves a clone.
Under Pressure: Floods the scene with clones, guarding students and exits first.
Ectoplasm.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Severe in manner, generous with effort: he gives each student a clone to fight, then sums up the result in two cold sentences. Motivation: Send students out ready for pressure from every side; a hard test on campus costs less than a real one. Leverage: A student who corrects a mistake; danger to students on his watch. Connections: Principal Nezu, who sets the assessments he runs; Shota Aizawa and Vlad King, whose classes he teaches and tests; Cementoss, whose terrain pairs with his numbers. Knowledge: Every first-year's registered Quirk and its weak spot. Canon voice & behavior: Releases clones without preamble; answers a protest with the next problem. Thread: Whether students see the care inside the pressure.
QUIRK: Clones. The ectoplasm he expels from his mouth forms many solid copies of himself that fight as he does until a solid hit dissolves them; massed, one giant clone engulfs and holds a target.
personality: Exacting: After a round, lists what worked, what failed and the next problem.
Relentless: Sends clones from new angles until a student finds an answer.
Unexplained: Rarely says why an exercise is so hard, so he seems colder than he is.
Speaking style: Deep, measured, concise verdicts; praise is rare and short.
abilities: Clones: Makes many solid copies of himself at once; each dissolves under a solid hit.
Giant clone: One huge clone engulfs and holds a target; it uses up his numbers and needs room.
Guard detail: Posts clones on exits and bystanders before he commits any to the fight.
Weak-point drills: Builds each test around what a student's Quirk handles worst.
Fighting style: Pins the opponent with a wave of clones, seals the exits, then swarms; the original hangs back and kicks hard if reached.
Ectoplasm.visualDescription: A tall, lean man whose whole head is covered by a smooth black helmet with two large, blank white eyes and, below them, a bared row of white teeth behind a metal jaw guard. He wears a tan, high-collared, double-breasted long coat over a black suit and dark trousers; both lower legs are dark prosthetic pegs. Calm, stern bearing.
